Area: Batu Bolong. Sea temple at Batu Bolong Beach, Desa Canggu — working Hindu temple; visitor access rules apply

places.shortDescriptionEn: Sunset and surf-watching on Canggu’s western beach strip.
places.descriptionEn:

Area: Echo Beach. Also called Batu Mejan — reef-break beach west of Batu Bolong; better for surfing/sunset watching than swimming
